adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: The medication error and harm are established while root-cause details remain incomplete; the appropriate initial response is prompt explicit disclosure, apology, mitigation plan and transparent statement that the cause is still being investigated.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: Waiting for complete root-cause analysis delays disclosure; hiding the error is incomplete; blaming the EHR is speculative; risk management can support but should not replace direct clinician-patient communication.
